limitations: No TPS25947 vendor macromodel; eFuse is an ideal voltage-controlled switch.
No TPS2121 vendor macromodel; MUX selection is idealized behavioral logic.
No analog OV2 clamp/bias circuit is modeled; BACKUP_READY gates the logical backup selection.
AUXOFF and FLT are held high in the TPS259470A counterexample; this represents documented output-fault status behavior, not a full pin model.
PG is modeled with threshold corners only; no 12 us typical deglitch or unguaranteed maximum delay is simulated.
The 1 A / 200 us proof pulse, 100 mV path-drop threshold, 11.8 V output minimum, divider ratio, COUT values, and load are screening assumptions, not approved hardware values.
This transient is a residual-voltage/path-qualification demonstration, not the 12 W / 1.2 s EOL hold-up simulation and not hardware evidence.
